brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive responsibility-chain completion with no errors. The doctor correctly identified the high-risk scenario (seizure + intracranial mass), provided appropriate emergency screening, accurate result interpretation, executable action plans, medication safety guidance, truthful disclosure navigation, and closed-loop confirmation. Two high-order points were completed: HO1 (patient-state-sensitive communication with specific scripts for the resistant patient) and HO2 (real-world constraint navigation including accommodation near hospital, ER pathway, and coordination strategies). The trajectory supported the family through a multi-day journey from initial consultation through surgery to discharge with consistent, safe, adaptive care.
